recommendation: Implement first (multi-carrier in ONE call, no carrier contract, free account): (1) Packlink PRO GET https://api.packlink.com/v1/services - simplest: one API key from the PRO web app, JSON, query-string inputs exactly matching ours (country+zip both sides, weight kg, L/W/H cm), returns every carrier with total/base/tax price, transit time, drop-off vs pickup and parcelshop flags. Caveat: not publicly documented; contract taken from Packlink's own open-source plugin core. (2) Boxtal API v1 GET /api/v1/cotation - French broker, free account, official SDK, returns HT and TTC prices per operator/service with collection (pickup/drop-off) and delivery (home/relay) types and delivery date. Caveats: XML, needs a content_code and a collection date, v1 keys distinct from v3, current host to confirm in sandbox. Boxtal v3 has NO quote endpoint. (3) Sendcloud v3 POST /shipping-options with calculate_quotes=true - best-documented modern JSON API, Basic auth public/secret key, can also price your own Colissimo/Chronopost contracts later; but plan/API-access conditions are unclear (Free plan API access disputed) and exact quote schema must be read on sendcloud.dev before coding. Skip for v1: carrier-direct APIs (UPS Rating, DHL MyDHL /rates, Chronopost QuickCost) each need a carrier account/contract and return one carrier only; Colissimo/Mondial Relay have no public rate API; La Poste Okapi 'tarifenvoi' (public counter tariff, weight only) status in 2026 unconfirmed. Implementation hint: wrap each provider in an adapter returning {provider, carrier, service, priceExclVat, priceInclVat, currency, transitDays|deliveryDate, pickupType, deliveryType} and run them in parallel from the Edge Function with secrets in Deno.env.
